observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor patiently explains the background of the dance and breaks down step-by-step variations from simple to complex. She demonstrates facing away from the camera for easier mirroring and encourages student engagement through comments.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and explains what the Hully Gully is.
Breaks down the first 8 counts facing away from the camera.
Teaches the step-hop and walk back phrase.
Introduces the augmented step version with a stomp.
Teaches the third variation with California shuffle.
Practices the dance routine with music.

cues: Keep on turning to the buttercups
metaphors: Keep on churning to the buttercups
common_mistakes: Starting on the wrong foot for the line dance rotation

steps_taught.name: Hully Gully Basic
steps_taught.description: Kick across and step together step to right and left

steps_taught.name: Step Hop and Walk
steps_taught.description: Step and hop forward ending with walk back

steps_taught.name: California Shuffle Variation
steps_taught.description: Adds California shuffle into the routine

what_works: Turning around to face away so viewers can mirror easily
Progressive layering from simple to more complex variations
what_hinders: Lack of slow count-in with music at first

quotes.text: The Hully Gully is a twenty beat line dance that is from the 1960s.
So, the first thing we're going to do... you should probably turn around.
Now, like I said, there are levels of difficulty of this, so I'm going to show you something that has an augmented step in it.
You can post a clip of you doing the Hully Gully right underneath the comment section.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher turns her back to the camera to demonstrate footwork so students can follow along directly.
Stepping and hopping forward followed by stepping back.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking the line dance into three distinct progressive levels of difficulty, starting simple and adding specific stylistic variations like the California shuffle.
